short_description: Capture coaching enquiries, qualify fit, schedule discovery calls, prepare context, and follow up on outcomes.

questions.question: Where do prospective clients first contact you?
What information do you collect before deciding whether to offer a discovery call?
options: None — anyone can book a call directly

questions.question: How do you decide whether a prospect is a fit, and what remains your personal judgement?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Check basic readiness/timeline, then coach personally judges rapport and coachability during call...

questions.question: How are available times shared and confirmed?
options: Online scheduling link with automatic calendar invite
Back-and-forth email or WhatsApp proposing times

questions.question: What preparation do you do before the call and where do you store it?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Review LinkedIn + intake notes in Google Doc or Notion 15 mins prior...

questions.question: How do you record the outcome and agreed next step?
options: Logged in CRM / coaching tool immediately after call
Notes written in notebook or separate doc; follow-up drafted later

questions.question: What happens when a prospect does not book, misses the call or needs a later follow-up?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Send one manual check-in email; often forgotten if busy...

short_description: Transition new coaching clients from agreement and payment through intake, scheduling, and session readiness.

questions.question: What event officially starts onboarding?
options: Signed coaching agreement AND first payment received

questions.question: How do you prepare, send and track the agreement?
options: Template sent via e-signature tool with automatic status tracking
Word/PDF edited manually and emailed for signature
Informal email terms without separate contract

questions.question: How do you confirm payment or an agreed payment plan?
options: Manually checking bank transfers / Stripe dashboard before emailing welcome

questions.question: What information do you collect about goals, expectations and working preferences?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Pre-coaching questionnaire covering 90-day outcomes, communication norms, and reflections...

questions.question: How do you schedule sessions and share joining details?
options: Client books recurring slots via calendar link with video link attached
Agreed over email and invites created manually
Booked one session at a time after each call

questions.question: What materials, access or preparation must be completed before session one?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Intake form submitted 48 hours before session one, shared folder access...

questions.question: Who checks readiness and what happens when a client has not completed a required step?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Coach notices morning of session and sends quick reminder...

short_description: Prepare session context, capture confidential notes and actions, send recaps, and track accountability.

questions.question: How do you prepare for each session and find the client's previous notes or actions?
options: Single client workspace / coaching platform checked before call
Searching Google Docs / Notion / email threads for last recap

questions.question: Where are session notes stored and who can access them?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Private coaching notes in Notion/notebook; shared action summary in client Google Doc...

questions.question: How are client commitments and coach actions captured?
options: Captured in shared action tracker during or right after session
Typed into recap email from rough notes
Left to the client to remember unless they ask

questions.question: How do you send a recap and agree the next actions?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Coach writes personalised recap email within 24 hours...

questions.question: How do you track overdue actions or clients who need support between sessions?
options: Mid-cycle check-in prompt or tracker review
Only reviewed when preparing for the next scheduled call
Client messages on WhatsApp/Slack if stuck

questions.question: What information is reviewed before the next session?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Previous session commitments, client pre-session check-in form...

questions.question: What should remain personal and confidential rather than being sent through automated messages?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Sensitive leadership dynamics, emotional reflections, confidential executive feedback...

short_description: Track engagement end dates, review progress, manage renewal conversations, and wrap up offboarding cleanly.

questions.question: How do you know when a coaching engagement is approaching its end?
options: Session counter / end-date alert in tracker
Often realised at the final session

questions.question: What evidence or progress measures are reviewed with the client?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Original 90-day goals vs outcomes achieved, qualitative reflection...

questions.question: Who initiates the renewal or completion conversation?
options: Coach raises it 2–3 sessions before end
Wait for client to ask about continuing

questions.question: How are new scope, duration and payment terms agreed?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Discussed on review call, then new agreement & invoice sent manually...

questions.question: What steps happen when a client completes or chooses not to continue?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Final wrap-up session, feedback request, cancel recurring billing...

questions.question: How are final resources, feedback and outstanding actions handled?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Send summary packet and testimonial link manually...

questions.question: How are records retained or access removed after the engagement ends?
options: Checklist to archive notes and revoke shared workspace access
Records stay wherever they are; access isn't systematically closed
